scope: Source-only audit of all 5 TPC-C and 5 Wikipedia selected operation identities. No DB/compiler/tests or benchmark edits. No native acceptance or performance claim.
definition: Sibling access interference means one queued activation can modify state/graph/control that changes another queued activation future DB access or cancellation. Ordinary loop/transaction dependence is reported separately. Output-only shared state still retains native output semantics.
assumptions: Single walker/request analysis with standard Jac plain field and graph-operation semantics; external concurrent transactions retain database isolation rules.
Known local helper bodies may be summarized. This is a source-derived feasibility assessment, not an implemented or machine-verified static analyzer.

cases.dependencies: Single Root ability. Repeated item/stock input IDs can alias the same Stock: quantity read-modify-write and replenishment branch form loop-carried dependence; exceptions must roll back preceding writes. District order-ID update precedes Order insertion.
cases.static_requirement: The absence of visit dispatch is syntactic. A may-alias storage-effect summary detects the sequential Stock effect; no unconditional distinct-stock proof is justified from arbitrary input lines.
cases.simplification: No benchmark edit is required merely to identify this dependency category.
cases.SQL_boundary: Read-only target discovery may be isolated from transactional mutations; do not delete validation/replenishment or replace rollback with validate-first and call it equivalent.

cases.dependencies: Single Root ability; input branch selects ID or name/median customer; balance/credit/history updates and timestamp call have visible effects.
cases.static_requirement: Control/data dependencies are explicit; transaction effects require memory/storage summaries.
cases.simplification: No benchmark edit is required merely to identify this dependency category.
cases.SQL_boundary: Separate customer lookup from mutations; business validation and credit semantics stay.

cases.dependencies: Single Root ability; customer selection and sorted order selection determine subsequent OrderLine read. No persisted mutations.
cases.static_requirement: Read-comprehension, sorting/selection, and may-raise summaries expose dependent relational reads.
cases.simplification: No benchmark edit is required merely to identify this dependency category.
cases.SQL_boundary: A relational selection/join region is possible in principle; no OSP sibling proof or implemented SQL support is claimed.

cases.dependencies: Single Root ability loops over districts; queries minimum pending Order, changes new_order/carrier/lines/customer totals. Under arbitrary shared topology an earlier write may affect another district iteration.
cases.static_requirement: Need may-alias graph/storage effects or declared district ownership/uniqueness invariant for loop independence.
cases.simplification: No benchmark edit is required merely to identify this dependency category.
cases.SQL_boundary: Preserve oldest-order selection, mutation order, owner checks and rollback; no guard removal recommended.

cases.dependencies: Single Root ability. Recent-order line scan builds item_ids used in a later stock membership filter. Output deduplication/reduction, no persistence writes.
cases.static_requirement: The data dependence is visible through the dictionary membership summary.
cases.simplification: No benchmark edit is required merely to identify this dependency category.
cases.SQL_boundary: Relational semijoin/distinct lowering can represent this phase dependence; not a sibling-dispatch issue.

cases.dependencies: Every visit schedules exactly one selected object: pages[0], revisions[0], texts[0]. page_id/latest_id/text_id are parent-to-child query parameters. Article and user_text are output state.
cases.static_requirement: Use visit singleton cardinality and plain field/read summaries; preserve error branches and ordered first selection.
cases.simplification: No benchmark edit is required merely to identify this dependency category.
cases.SQL_boundary: No simplification required. Eligible parameterized lookup chains can be considered for lowering; result/error semantics remain native unless supported.

cases.dependencies: Same singleton Page/Revision/Text chain; user/group/block checks precede visits, outputs use selected user text.
cases.static_requirement: Same singleton and read summary; user validation/exception is a control boundary, not sibling mutation.
cases.simplification: No benchmark edit is required merely to identify this dependency category.
cases.SQL_boundary: No simplification required; retain user validation, group and block behavior.

cases.dependencies: Single Root ability loops main/talk namespaces; duplicate checks, insertion, and user timestamp updates; duplicate second operation may roll back first.
cases.static_requirement: Loop/effect/exception summaries expose transaction dependencies; namespaces are explicitly distinct but this does not remove rollback semantics.
cases.simplification: No benchmark edit is required merely to identify this dependency category.
cases.SQL_boundary: Do not delete duplicate guards or change partial-write rollback test.

cases.dependencies: Single Root ability; scoped Watch lookup/destruction and user timestamp. remove_node calls Jac.destroy.
cases.static_requirement: Interprocedural summary for the available remove_node helper marks storage deletion; _now is an external time input.
cases.simplification: No benchmark edit is required merely to identify this dependency category.
cases.SQL_boundary: Read target regions may be separate; deletion/timestamp are business effects.

cases.dependencies: Single Root ability; ID maxima, inserts, revision/page links, latest revision updates, watcher reads and notification updates, log/user writes.
cases.static_requirement: Ordinary value and storage dependencies are explicit; need transactional ordering and ID allocation assumptions, not a sibling queue model.
cases.simplification: No benchmark edit is required merely to identify this dependency category.
cases.SQL_boundary: Full update lowering requires transaction/effect semantics. No semantics-preserving deletion of these operations proposed.
